caption:
Stuck on an error for hours? 😩 Paste it into AI with this prompt and get the cause, the fix and how to avoid it next time.

Comment "PROMPT" for more developer prompts 📩

#developers #coding #programming #aiprompts #chatgpt #debugging #techtips #smartwork

scenes.title: Copy this prompt
scenes.text: I'm getting this error in my [language/framework] code: [paste error]. Here is the code: [paste code]. Explain in simple words: 1) what caused it, 2) the exact fix, 3) how to prevent it next time.

scenes.title: AI's version:
scenes.text: Cause: the list is empty, so index 0 does not exist. Fix: check if the list has items before reading it. Prevent: always handle empty results from the database.
scenes.tip: Tip: paste the full error, not just one line
